Since 1.21.2 all zombie types can break doors if instructed as MC-137053 was fixed. Checks if this zombie type supports breaking doors. Drowned do not have support for breaking doors so using setCanBreakDoors(boolean) on them has no effect. Returns: true if entity supports breaking doors
